page.overview:
What is Koffing?

Koffing is a Poison Gas Pokémon. Its body is purple and spherical with a skull and crossbones on the lower parts of its body. It has openings that allow gases to escape. A Koffing will spew a harmless gas if its happy, and a poisonous gas if it's angry. Koffing mainly eats rotten kitchen garbage.

Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, but they are also explosive. Koffing's signature attack is Poison Gas.

Koffing evolves into Weezing starting at level 35.
